notes: This is the Tadawul (Saudi Exchange) version, separate/independent from the US config.json version. Trades directly in SAR, so there is no USD conversion here. Tadawul trades Sunday-Thursday ~10:00-15:00 AST, unlike the US market's Mon-Fri evening session, so it runs on its own schedule and does not overlap with the US tracker. purification_pct is the fraction of each realized profit set aside (0.1 = 10%). ntfy_topic is a separate channel from the US version so alerts don't mix -- subscribe to it separately in the ntfy app.
